intro: Introducing FindHouse. The easiest way for brokers to list homes. Just send the details on WhatsApp, and we build your website.
pain: Listing a home usually means the same copy-paste, again and again.
send: Just send the photos and details to FindHouse on WhatsApp, then say done.
link: In twenty seconds, your listing is back, with photos sorted by room, and one link to share.
site: Customers see your own website, with your name, the price, the photos, and one tap to call or WhatsApp you.
share: Share the link in one tap, and your customer sees everything instantly. Happy customers, faster enquiries.
manage: In your dashboard, manage every property. Mark it active or rented, edit the details, and share the link anywhere.
private: Want a home to stay hidden? Make it private, and share it with just one customer.
performance: Then track your performance. Views, enquiries, occupancy and rent, all at a glance.
close: Are you ready to start? List your next property. Message FindHouse on WhatsApp, or visit findhouse dot in.
